method: Half the period of the transfer ellipse, from vis-viva and Kepler. Reproduces the published 146 d, which is the check that the rest of the transit curve is worth reading.
used_for: The whole transit argument, and the six-months-is-a-choice section.
wrong_if: The orbits are treated as circular and coplanar. They are neither, and a real mission planner would get a different number by a day or two depending on the launch window.
